description: S462 (dpa-069 item 7): the sink pin of `undeclared-attr-srcdoc-each-lift-neg`, moved onto a PLAIN element. `srcdoc=it.d` on a body-authored `<iframe>` in `lift` AND in `<each>` writes row data into an HTML document — refused at the write, in both positions. Under O18 (RULED S462, SPEC §66.6.9) no §66 use-site attribute reaches an element, so this is the route a `srcdoc` sink takes in a §66 program; the component-route case stays for impl#1's legacy `const X = <…>` form through its §63 window. COVERAGE NOTE: this case and its twin `on-attr-lift-each-plain-listener-pos` are NOT-TWINNED for the bootstrap (rhs-decl: an array of non-scalar elements needs a type — O35, docs/bootstrap-conformance.md), so the coverage is impl#1-only for now.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457) `srcdoc` in every form: "A `srcdoc` attribute (any case) on an element whose value is not a static string — … a variable `srcdoc=@doc` / `srcdoc=it.html` … — SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE) in every position rule 2 names" (`<each>` rows and `lift` markup among them).
